methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched via WebFetch on 2026-06-15 for Baremetrics (baremetrics.com/pricing), ChartMogul (chartmogul.com/pricing/), Recurly (recurly.com/pricing/ + recurly.com/product/security-compliance/), Putler (putler.com/pricing/), RevenueCat (revenuecat.com/pricing/), and Paddle/ProfitWell (paddle.com/profitwell-metrics). For Polar Analytics the official polaranalytics.com/pricing page is demo-gated and publishes NO prices; the draft's third-party (pricingsaas.com) figures were replaced with first-party module prices from Polar's public pricing calculator at pricing.polaranalytics.ai. All monthlyUsd values are the lowest published starting price for the entry tier where pricing scales with ARR/GMV/revenue; 'custom'/'contact sales'/enterprise plans with no published price are recorded as monthlyUsd null (a null beats a guess). Telephony fields are null (not applicable to this vertical). accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Baremetrics
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched baremetrics.com/pricing 2026-06-15: Launch $75, Growth $255, Scale $1,152, all with 35% annual discount and add-ons (Payment Recovery +$129/mo, Cancellation Insights +$129/mo) confirmed on the live page. GDPR page exists (baremetrics.com/gdpr); SOC2 not stated on the pricing/security copy fetched, so left null. Free-trial duration not printed on the pricing page; 14 days retained from search corroboration only.

plans.name: Launch
plans.notes: For businesses with up to $360K ARR. Includes 1 integration, subscription analytics, trial insights, automated email reports, autogenerated segments, data enrichment, and chat support.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: For businesses with $360K-$3.6M ARR. Includes 2 integrations, everything in Launch plus custom dashboards, unlimited segmentation, benchmarks, advanced exports, goal tracking, Slack and Intercom integrations.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: For businesses with $3.6M+ ARR. Unlimited integrations, scenario planning, budget and expense tracking, analytics API, dedicated support rep.

limits: Payment Recovery and Cancellation Insights are paid add-ons (+$129/mo each)
enrichment.provenance: Plan prices, 35% annual discount, and add-on pricing confirmed from baremetrics.com/pricing on 2026-06-15. SOC2 not confirmed first-party (left null); GDPR true via baremetrics.com/gdpr. Free-trial length is search-corroborated, not printed on the pricing page.

vendors.name: ChartMogul
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched chartmogul.com/pricing/ 2026-06-15: Free (forever, up to $120K ARR), Starter from $69/mo monthly billing ($59 annual), Pro from $119/mo monthly billing ($99 annual), 17% annual discount, Enterprise from $19,900/year. Compliance confirmed from chartmogul.com/security/.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Forever free up to $120K ARR. Includes 1 billing source, 5 team dashboards, built-in CRM, core revenue analytics. No credit card required.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Starts at $69/mo monthly billing (scales up to ~$499/mo at higher ARR tiers, up to $10M ARR). Annual billing from $59/mo (17% off). Up to 3 team members, 1 billing source, 5 dashboards, CRM sync.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Starts at $119/mo monthly billing (scales up to ~$1,199/mo at higher ARR tiers, up to $10M ARR). Annual billing from $99/mo (17% off). Unlimited team members, up to 5 billing sources, 10 dashboards, data warehouse exports, two-way CRM sync.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: From $19,900/year (annual contract) for $10M+ ARR. Unlimited billing sources, Power BI integration, dedicated expert support, 15 dashboards. No published monthly price.

limits: Starter: max 3 team members, 1 billing source
enrichment.provenance: Plan prices (monthly vs annual) confirmed from chartmogul.com/pricing/ on 2026-06-15. SOC2 Type II and GDPR confirmed from chartmogul.com/security/; HIPAA not mentioned. freeTrialDays set null: the entry is a true forever-free tier, not a trial-gated model.

vendors.name: Recurly
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched recurly.com/pricing/ 2026-06-15: Starter $249/mo + 0.9% (first $40K billings free), 90-day trial; All-Access and All-Access for Shopify are custom (contact sales, <1% billing volume, $1M minimum); Engage from $1,600/mo and RevRec from $850/mo, both billed annually. plans.name: Starter

plans.notes: Less than 1% of billing volume, billed annually. Requires minimum $1M billing volume. AI-powered analytics, intelligent churn-prevention, multiple dunning campaigns, payments orchestration, custom reporting, multicurrency, SSO. No published monthly price.

plans.name: All-Access for Shopify
plans.notes: Less than 1% of billing volume, billed annually. Shopify-native subscription capabilities with cancel-save flows, subscriber portal, bundle support. No published monthly price.

plans.name: Engage
plans.notes: Starts at $1,600/month, billed annually. AI propensity-to-churn model, personalized offers, A/B testing, segmentation, advanced analytics. Requires annual commitment.

plans.name: RevRec
plans.notes: Starts at $850/month, billed annually. Automated revenue recognition, contract modifications, SSP automation, multi-GAAP compliance, immutable audit trail.

limits: Starter requires $40K+/month billing to avoid per-transaction fee impact
